title: 一幅油画是怎样一层层画出来的
topic: How an oil painting is built up, layer by layer

sentences.en: Today, let's see how an oil painting gets made. It's rarely one burst of inspiration, but a slow, layered process.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来看看一幅油画是怎么画出来的。它很少是灵感的一瞬爆发，而是缓慢、层层叠加的过程。

sentences.en: The artist stretches a canvas on an easel and begins with a sketch, mapping out the composition and the contour of the shapes.
sentences.zh: 艺术家把画布架在画架上，先用素描起稿，勾出构图和形状的轮廓。

sentences.en: To show deep space, the artist works out the perspective, the way Renaissance painters used linear perspective for the illusion of depth.
sentences.zh: 为了表现纵深，艺术家会推敲透视，就像文艺复兴画家用线性透视营造出深度的错觉。

sentences.en: Then color comes in. Paint is really pigment, a fine colored powder, and in oil painting the medium is oil.
sentences.zh: 接着颜色登场。颜料其实是有色细粉，而油画的媒材是油。

sentences.en: The artist mixes the paints on a palette, where a single hue becomes many shades; palette also means an artist's whole color range.
sentences.zh: 艺术家在调色板上调和颜料，同一个色相可调出多种色度；palette 也指艺术家所用的整体色彩范围。

sentences.en: Applied in layers, this slow-drying oil lets the painter shade an area gradually, giving a flat image a sense of solid volume.
sentences.zh: 油分层涂上去，这种干得慢的油让画家能循序渐进地加暗，使平面图像有了实在的体积感。

sentences.en: Layering also builds texture; where paint is thick, you see each brushstroke. Watercolor is the opposite, thin and transparent, drying so fast that mistakes are hard to fix.
sentences.zh: 分层还形成肌理；颜料厚处，能看到每一道笔触。水彩正相反，薄而透明，干得极快，一旦画错就很难改。

sentences.en: Painting is only one branch of the fine arts. A sculptor works in three dimensions. One approach is carving: Michelangelo carved figures from marble with a chisel.
sentences.zh: 绘画只是美术的一个分支。雕塑家在三维中创作。一种做法是雕凿：米开朗基罗用凿子从大理石中雕出人像。

sentences.en: The other approach adds material: the artist builds the form in soft clay and may engrave fine detail into the surface.
sentences.zh: 另一种做法是添加材料：艺术家用柔软的黏土把形体塑出来，还可在表面镌刻精细的细节。

sentences.en: For a bronze sculpture, that clay model makes a mold; molten bronze is poured in to cool, a step we call casting.
sentences.zh: 要做青铜雕塑，这个黏土模型用来翻制模具；把熔化的青铜倒进去冷却，这一步我们称为浇铸。

sentences.en: Clay also leads us to pottery. A shaped clay object is fired in a kiln, whose heat turns soft clay permanently hard.
sentences.zh: 黏土也把我们引向陶艺。塑好形的黏土器物要放进窑里烧制，窑的高温让软黏土永久变硬。

sentences.en: The potter often adds a glaze, a thin layer of glass melted onto the surface that seals the pottery and adds shine.
sentences.zh: 陶工常再施一层釉，那是熔在表面、能封住陶器并增添光泽的一薄层玻璃。

sentences.en: One more technique: in a fresco, pigment is brushed onto wet plaster, so as it dries the color becomes part of the wall.
sentences.zh: 还有一种技法：作湿壁画时，颜料涂在潮湿的灰泥上，灰泥变干时颜色便嵌入墙体。

sentences.en: So whether it is a portrait, a landscape, an abstract canvas, or a mural, a finished work is never one gesture but many steps.
sentences.zh: 所以无论是肖像、风景、抽象画布，还是壁画，一件完成的作品从来不是一个动作，而是许多耐心的步骤。
